title: veronica agrestis var. opaca
intro: Veronica agrestis var. opaca, commonly known as Wood Speedwell, is a flowering plant that belongs to the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat a range of ailments, including respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Veronica agrestis var. opaca include acting as an expectorant to ease coughs and congestion, and its anti-inflammatory properties help to reduce swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
